items.originalTitle: Everything we learned from F1's wet Las Vegas GP practice running
items.summaryEn: The Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend opened with wet practice running that teams and drivers had not hoped for, yet the limited feedback still revealed some current limitations.
detailZh: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末以（非常）湿滑的练习赛开场，这并非F1车队或车手所期望的，而本周末其余时间预计将是干燥天气。
尽管如此，缺乏跑圈和有限的反馈仍让我们了解到当前的一些限制，以及第二次练习赛排名中的一些意外结果在多大程度上可能代表后续走势。
周五首次练习赛前所未有地没有出现任何计时圈，这令人遗憾地反映出拉斯维加斯今年在湿地条件下变得更糟。
拉斯维加斯大道赛道过去就已因低温、低抓地力和高速布局而成为非常棘手的挑战，而在湿地条件下，光滑的表面意味着水容易积聚其上并引发水滑现象。
但哈斯车队车手奥利·贝尔曼表示，这已经变成了“灾难的配方”，因为2026款赛车抓地力低下，而且湿地胎和半雨胎都太硬、难以升温——这就是为什么几乎没人在第一节练习中尝试开始飞驰圈。
多支车队反馈，无论如何都无法让轮胎升温——以至于倍耐力甚至提高了车队在第二节练习中可用的轮胎加温毯温度，试图在条件相似的情况下让第二节练习多跑一些。
新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德首次体验拉斯维加斯，他说“即使在低速弯以100公里/小时行驶也真的很吓人，四个轮子都在打滑，不知道会不会撞墙”，并补充道：“我能最接近地类比的是在冰面上开拉力赛车对比一级方程式赛车。”
而梅赛德斯车队在第二节练习中跑出最快圈速的乔治·拉塞尔表示，2026款赛车的一个特定特性——在直道上同时打开前后翼的主动空气动力学系统——与拉斯维加斯的长直道很不匹配，因为这意味着轮胎在弯道之间又会变得太冷。
“由于到处都是慢速弯区域，轮胎上没有任何垂直载荷，所以轮胎在直道上比过去三年降温幅度大得多，”他说。“而且它们本来就已经很凉了。”
第一节练习的条件太差，小红牛车队领队艾伦·珀曼说“没有任何可学的东西，连安装圈都算不上”。
第二节练习在里程方面好得多，车手们合计完成了400多圈，但实际上这节练习也没什么用。珀曼称这只是在把冷却调整到正确窗口的练习，否则“我认为没有任何真正有意义的东西可学”。
预计周末剩余时间将是干燥的，所以即使雨早早停了，车手们也没有获得有价值的经验。湿地赛道太危险，据贝尔曼说，尽管90%的赛道是干的，光头胎根本不可行——如果在其他任何赛道这么湿，车队会换上光头胎并跑得“快得多得多”。
其他人也有同感。阿斯顿·马丁车队的佩德罗·德·拉·罗萨表示，“你学到的东西显然无关紧要”，法拉利副领队杰罗姆·丹布罗西奥称周五的练习“会有点像是重新开始”，而迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里则表示，第二节自由练习“对本周剩余时间来说绝对不太相关”。
这让周六和周日变成了一种迷你冲刺赛周末，因为在这种赛制下，车队在确定排位赛之前能跑的赛道时间非常少——这至少带来了一个有趣的看点：有些车队可能会判断失误，从而可能导致名次出现混乱。
阿尔派车队没有人把皮埃尔·加斯利在练习赛中拿到第二名——距离第一名仅0.071秒——特别当回事。虽然那是一个好看的飞驰圈，在一个不寻常的日子里看到一支弱队排名如此之高通常也令人愉快，但这个成绩更多是因为在逐渐变干的赛道上把握住了时机，而非其他因素。
但即使这已经是本周末阿尔派在成绩表上能取得的最高位置，车队仍然相信拉斯维加斯将是其近期低迷状态结束的地方。
“我们刚刚经历了相当糟糕的六场比赛——六场比赛里我们只拿到一分，”董事总经理史蒂夫·尼尔森承认道。
“拉斯维加斯是我们认为并希望会适合我们的赛道。所以我们期待明天和比赛日的干地运行，我们抱有希望。”
阿尔派的常规主要竞争对手小红牛车队也有同样的预期。
“我预计他们会很快，”佩尔曼说。
“他们在蒙扎很快[加斯利在干地情况下拿到令人震惊的杆位]，在巴库也很快，而这是一条非常相似的赛道。”
但佩尔曼补充说“自那两场比赛以来，我们确实取得了一些进步”。
而在阿尔派恩“糟糕”的那段时间里，小红牛在争夺车队第五名的战斗中从仅领先九分，变成了在还剩三场比赛时稳握45分优势。
不少车队都带来了升级，即便只是小升级，在赛季如此深入、又在拉斯维加斯这样独特的赛道上——但这些部件也成了条件的牺牲品。
迈凯伦认为在兰多·诺里斯的赛车上冒险使用新底板并不明智，红牛则选择不测试前翼升级。两队都将在预计为干地的第三次练习赛中再次尝试。
小红牛在前翼、底板边缘和后角进行了调整，但佩尔曼表示“在这些条件下我们无法评估它们”。
真正获得一些有用里程的是升级后的梅赛德斯涡轮增压器，它正在多辆赛车上运行：基米·安东内利的厂队赛车以及所有客户车队。
“对我们来说最重要的是新引擎，”威廉姆斯车手亚历克斯·阿尔本说道。
更多是校准设置，而不是其他任何东西。但看起来不错。看起来就像他们所说的那样。
尽管周五的价值如此之低，但值得注意的是，马克斯·维斯塔潘在第二次练习赛中只需要九圈就对红牛赛车感到不满。
在最初抱怨引擎升温时的动力响应后，维斯塔潘很快对赛车本身更加担忧。
技术总监皮埃尔·瓦什表示红牛有“大量工作要做”，并且马克斯“不太高兴”（尽管伊萨克·哈贾尔很高兴）。
“关键在于赛车平衡，”瓦赫说道。“他对赛车的表现并不满意。”
“我们正在努力弄清楚问题出在哪里。”
在阿斯顿·马丁车队周五分别获得第10名和第11名之后，费尔南多·阿隆索是否想借机强调雨天是均衡器，并展望一番爆冷击败强敌的可能性？
不。他完全没这个意思。
他说：“今天并不是很有代表性的一天。我认为有一半的车手都没有跑任何圈数。所以这就是为什么我们的排名会稍微高一些。”
阿隆索觉得拉斯维加斯直道的长度意味着即便是下雨也弥补不了本田的短板，他说“差距相当大”。
他计划利用周五剩余的练习时间来研究正赛长距离的轮胎策略，并考虑到可能出现的颗粒化问题，因为他已经预料到自己在排位赛或起步阶段取得的任何成果都会在直道上迅速被抵消。
阿隆索说：“在第一圈我们无论如何都会丢掉大部分位置。所以我认为我们需要把注意力集中在轮胎上。”
detailEn: A day of (very) wet running at the start of a Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend that's otherwise expected to be dry wasn't really what Formula 1 teams or drivers were looking for.
Still, the lack of running and limited feedback told us plenty about some current limitations - and just how representative some surprises in the FP2 order are likely to be of what follows.
An unprecedented absence of timed laps in Friday's first practice session was a sad reflection of how Las Vegas has been made even worse in the wet this year.

The Las Vegas Strip circuit was already a very tricky challenge in the past due to low temperatures and a low-grip, high-speed track layout, and in the wet the smooth surface means water pools easily on top of it and causes aquaplaning.

But it's become a "recipe for disaster", Haas driver Ollie Bearman said, with the low-grip 2026 cars and both wet and intermediate tyres that are so stiff and hard to warm up - which is why hardly anybody even attempted to start a flying lap in FP1.

Several teams reported that there was nothing that could be done for generating tyre temperature - so much so that Pirelli even bumped up the blanket temperatures teams could have for FP2, to try to get a bit more running in the second session in case conditions were similar.

Rookie Arvid Lindblad, experiencing Vegas for the first time, said it was "honestly scary to drive even at 100km/h in a low-speed corner, just four wheels sliding, not knowing if you're going to go into a wall" and added: "The closest I can relate to it was driving a rally car on ice versus Formula 1."

And Mercedes' FP2 pacesetter George Russell said one specific 2026 feature - the active aero that opens both front and rear wings on the straights - is a bad match for Vegas's long straights because it means the tyres get too cold again between corners.

"With the SM zones everywhere, you're not putting any vertical load in the tyre, so the tyres are getting substantially cooler in the straight than they have been in the last three years," he said. "And they were already cool."
Conditions were so poor in FP1 that Racing Bulls team principal Alan Permane said "there wasn't anything to learn, not even an installation lap".

FP2 was much better in terms of mileage as the drivers managed more than 400 laps between them, but actually this session wasn't much use either. Permane called it an exercise in getting the cooling in the right window, otherwise "I don't think there was anything really meaningful to learn".

The rest of the weekend is expected to be dry so there were no valuable lessons for the drivers even though the rain stopped early. The track was so treacherous in the wet that, according to Bearman, slicks were simply not viable even though 90% of the circuit was dry - and that if it was that wet on any other track, teams would bolt on slicks and go "much, much quicker".

Others felt the same. Aston Martin's Pedro de la Rosa said it was "obviously irrelevant what you learned", Ferrari deputy team principal Jerome d'Ambrosio said Friday's running "will be a bit of a reset", and McLaren driver Oscar Piastri said FP2 was "definitely not super-relevant for the rest of the week".

It turns Saturday and Sunday into something of a mini-sprint weekend, given how little track running there is in that format before teams commit to qualifying - which at least raises the fun prospect of some getting it wrong and there being the potential for a mixed-up order as a result.

No one at Alpine was taking Pierre Gasly's second place in practice - just 0.071 seconds from first - particularly seriously. While it was a fun lap to watch and generally nice to see an underdog that high up on an unusual day, the result was more about timing on a drying track than anything else.
But even if that's as high as it will appear on a results sheet this weekend, Alpine's still confident Vegas is going to be the place its recent slump ends.
"We've come off the back of a fairly dire six races - we've got one point in six races," managing director Steve Nielsen acknowledged.
"Vegas is the track we think and hope will suit us. And so we're looking forward to dry running tomorrow and race day and we're hopeful."
Alpine's usual main rival Racing Bulls has the same expectation.
"I expect them to be quick," said Permane.
"They were quick in Monza [where Gasly took a shock pole in the dry], they were quick in Baku, and this is a very similar kind of track."
But Permane added "we've certainly made some steps since those two races".

And during Alpine's "dire" spell, Racing Bulls has gone from being just nine points ahead in their battle for fifth in the constructors' championship to a surely-safe 45 points clear with three races left.
A decent number of teams have brought upgrades, even if they are just minor ones, this deep into the season on a track as unique as Vegas - but these parts were victims of the conditions too.
McLaren didn’t feel it was sensible to risk running a new floor on Lando Norris's car, and Red Bull opted against trialling a front wing update. Both will try again in FP3 when it is meant to be dry.
Racing Bulls had tweaks across the front wing, floor board and rear corner but Permane said "we can't assess them in these conditions".
What did get some useful mileages was the upgraded Mercedes turbocharger that's running in several cars: Kimi Antonelli's works machine plus all the customer teams.
"The main thing for us was the new engine," said Williams driver Alex Albon.
"More calibration settings than anything else. But it looks good. It looks like what they said it would do."
Though Friday was of so little value, it was telling that Max Verstappen only needed nine laps in FP2 to be unhappy with Red Bull's car.
Having initially complained about the power response while the engine came up to temperature, Verstappen quickly became more concerned by the car itself.
Technical director Pierre Wache said Red Bull has a "lot of work to do" and that Max was "not very happy" (although Isack Hadjar was).
"It's about the car balance," said Wache. "He was not happy with how the car behaved.
"We are trying to understand where it's coming from."
Did Fernando Alonso fancy a chance to talk up the rain being a leveller and the prospect of some giant-killing after the Aston Martins finished Friday 10th and 11th?
No. He really didn't.
"It was a not very representative day," he said. "I think half of the grid didn't put any laps in. So that's why we are a little bit higher."
Alonso felt the length of the Las Vegas straights meant even rain wouldn't make up for Honda's shortcomings, saying "the deficit was quite big".

He's planning to spend Friday's remaining practice session figuring out tyre tactics for long runs in the race, with potential graining in mind, as he's already expecting anything he achieves in qualifying or at the start to be swiftly negated on the straights.
"In lap one we will lose most of the places anyway. So I think we need to concentrate on the tyres," Alonso said.

keyPointsEn: No timed laps were set in the first practice session, an unprecedented occurrence in Las Vegas.
The smooth surface of the Las Vegas Strip circuit pools water easily in the wet and causes aquaplaning.

items.originalTitle: "Same as Brazil" – Red Bull "trying to understand" the root cause of Max Verstappen's complaints
items.summaryEn: Red Bull technical director Pierre Waché said after Thursday's practice sessions in Las Vegas that the team is again dealing with a balance issue, the same as in Brazil, and is trying to understand the root cause of Max Verstappen's complaints. Rain meant the team could not test its minor upgrade, and Verstappen only set his first timed lap in the final five minutes.
detailZh: “和巴西站一样”——红牛“试图理解”马克斯·维斯塔潘抱怨的根源
皮埃尔·瓦谢在首节练习赛后说明，红牛再次面对平衡问题。由于下雨，车队尚未在拉斯维加斯测试其小幅升级
拉斯维加斯周四练习赛后，红牛和所有F1车队一样，几乎没有得到答案。伊萨克·哈贾尔最终在计时榜上排名第四，但考虑到周末剩余时间不再有雨，这一成绩意义不大。
因此练习日的条件不具代表性，这正是马克斯·维斯塔潘长时间留在车库的原因。直到最后五分钟、后期红旗之后，这位荷兰车手才做出首个计时圈。实在没有太多可学的东西。
尽管如此，维斯塔潘在赛道上短暂亮相期间对小红牛22并不满意。
事情始于一个疑似动力单元问题，维斯塔潘在出场圈报告动力不足。红牛回应称这主要与低温有关，并且会自行改善，不过维斯塔潘回答说：“这不正常！”
本节练习结束后，技术总监皮埃尔·瓦谢解释了这些抱怨背后的原因，维斯塔潘的队友哈贾尔也提出了同样的抱怨。
“我认为这主要是能量管理和MGU-K在单圈中的部署问题。在这方面做了一些微调，以确保为单圈优化，”瓦谢说。
“在这种条件下，抓地力如此之低，能量管理的适应对我们来说需要一些时间。”
然而，这并不是维斯塔潘唯一的抱怨。这位四届世界冠军还在车队无线电中说：“这辆车不好，伙计们，和巴西一样的问题。”
瓦谢强调，这与DM01动力单元无关，也与发动机制动无关——这是今年经常困扰维斯塔潘的另一个方面——而纯粹是赛车的平衡问题。
“不，那与动力单元无关。这是关于赛车平衡的问题，他对赛车的行为方式不满意。我们正试图弄清楚问题出在哪里。”
在圣保罗，维斯塔潘表示，在使用中性胎的第一段比赛后，赛车的平衡完全改变了。据他说，这不能完全用换上干地胎来解释，因为在最后几圈使用中性胎时，赛车的感觉也与开场阶段截然不同。
在拉斯维加斯的练习赛中，维斯塔潘在赛车尾部遇到了同样的平衡问题，红牛将在排位赛前对此进行调查。
尽管如此，哈贾尔表示他对这条街道赛道有“良好的感觉”，不过瓦谢还不准备完全认同这种乐观情绪。
“我从不乐观。我们有很多工作要做，但不知道我们处在什么位置。我认为每个人都在带来某种升级。有些车队甚至带来了引擎升级。”
“我们看看自己处在什么位置。很难说。目前，马克斯对赛车不太满意，而伊萨克挺满意。我们得在这上面下功夫，看看如何把它推演到明天的条件下。”
虽然瓦谢提到了升级，但红牛也为内华达沙漠带来了一处小更新。它涉及前翼端板的一处小改动，哈贾尔说这值“不到十分之一秒”。
然而，由于条件棘手，红牛尚未能测试这个新部件，将不得不等到第三节练习再试。
“是的，我们也带来了一些更新，主要想在这里测试它。原本计划在第一节练习测试，但我们没能做到，第二节练习也一样。我们必须在干地上跑它，希望明天早上能够做到。”
detailEn: "Same as Brazil" – Red Bull "trying to understand" the root cause of Max Verstappen's complaints
Pierre Waché clarifies after the opening practice sessions that Red Bull is dealing with a balance issue again. The team has not yet been able to test its minor upgrade in Las Vegas due to the rain

After Thursday's practice sessions in Las Vegas, Red Bull – like all Formula 1 teams – has been left with very few answers. Isack Hadjar eventually finished fourth on the timesheets, but that means very little given that no more rain is forecast for the remainder of the weekend.

The conditions were therefore not representative during the practice day, and that was precisely why Max Verstappen stayed in the garage for so long. It was only in the final five minutes, following the late red flag, that the Dutchman set his first timed lap. There was simply very little to learn.
Nevertheless, Verstappen was not happy with the RB22 during his brief appearance on track.

It started with a suspected power unit issue, with Verstappen reporting a lack of power on his out-lap. Red Bull responded by explaining that it was mainly related to the low temperatures and would improve on its own, although Verstappen replied: "This is not normal!"
After the session, technical director Pierre Waché explained the background to these complaints, which were also heard from Verstappen's team-mate Hadjar.
"I think it's mainly energy management and the MGU-K deployment around the lap. There was a little bit of fine-tuning on that aspect to make sure that it's optimised for the lap," Waché said.
"When the grip is so low in these conditions, the adaptation of the energy management takes some time on our side."
However, that was not Verstappen's only complaint. The four-time world champion also said over the team radio: "This car is not good guys, same problem as Brazil."
Waché stressed that this was not related to the DM01 power unit, nor to engine braking – another aspect that has frequently troubled Verstappen this year – but purely to the car's balance.
"No, that's not about the power unit. It’s about the car balance, he was not happy with how the car behaved. We are trying to understand where it's coming from."

In Sao Paulo, Verstappen said that the balance had changed completely after the first stint on intermediates. According to him, this could not be fully explained by the switch to slick tyres, as the car also felt very different during the final laps on inters compared to the opening phase.
During practice in Las Vegas, Verstappen experienced the same balance problems at the rear of the car, something Red Bull will look into ahead of qualifying.
Nevertheless, Hadjar said he has "a good feeling" about this street circuit, although Waché is not yet prepared to fully share that optimism.
"I'm never optimistic. We have a lot of work to do, but it's unknown where we are. I think everybody is bringing some kind of update. Some teams are even bringing some engine updates.
"We will see where we are. It's difficult to say. At the moment, Max is not very happy with the car, and Isack is. We have to work on it and see how we can extrapolate it to tomorrow’s conditions."

While Waché mentioned upgrades, Red Bull has also brought a minor update to the Nevada desert. It involves a small modification to the front wing endplate, which Hadjar has said is worth "less than a tenth".
However, due to the tricky conditions, Red Bull has not yet been able to test the new part and will have to wait until the third practice session to do so.

"Yeah, we also brought some update, we mainly want to test it here. It was planned to test it in FP1, which we were not able to do, and the same for FP2. We have to run it in the dry and we will hope to be able to do it tomorrow morning."

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton plans "GTA VI" session after Vegas FP2: "I'm like a big kid"
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿计划在拉斯维加斯FP2之后玩"GTA VI"："我就像一个孩子"
法拉利车手在拉斯维加斯告诉粉丝，他将在周四晚上早点回酒店玩新发布的游戏
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在拉斯维加斯大奖赛的第二场练习赛中以第六名的成绩结束，在承诺粉丝将会有一个早睡的夜晚后，他在酒店里玩新发布的《侠盗猎车手VI》。
七次世界冠军在周二晚上，在拉斯维加斯的PUMA Under the Lights粉丝活动上发言，距离游戏发布还有两天。
“两天后会有新游戏发布，”汉密尔顿对观众说，然后他介绍了周四的计划，当第二场练习在当地时间晚上9点结束时。
“所以周四晚上，我会早点回到酒店，”他说。
“我就像一个大孩子，”他补充道，然后对观众中的老粉丝们说，他希望他们能挖掘自己内心的孩子。
41岁的他承认这一点是在同一个活动中，他在那里透露了他收集宝可梦卡片的爱好，并说他曾带他的侄子和侄女去买卡包。
GTA VI，自2013年GTA V以来，Rockstar系列中的首款新主要游戏，在经历了几次延迟后于周四发布。
在周三的媒体日再次被问及此事时，汉密尔顿确认他在拉斯维加斯带着他的PlayStation，并将其称为“史上最受期待的游戏”。然而，他开玩笑说，F1游戏更有可能帮助他取得更好的成绩。
在开始任何游戏之前，汉密尔顿还有工作要做。法拉利青训车队车手Dino Beganovic在第一场练习中驾驶了他的赛车，但由于下雨，没有设定圈速，使得第二场练习成为了汉密尔顿当天唯一的实际跑圈。
在潮湿的赛道上，气温低至11摄氏度，他和查尔斯·勒克莱尔曾短暂地以中胎领跑，但随着赛道的不断改善，他们最终的位置有所变动。汉密尔顿以第六名的成绩结束本节练习，落后计时表领跑者乔治·罗素1.211秒，勒克莱尔排名第三。
汉密尔顿并不是唯一一个期待拿着手柄放松的车手。车队中最著名的游戏玩家之一，马克斯·维斯塔潘表示游戏已经“预先下载”，但他承认“还没有时间玩游戏”。维斯塔潘在FP2中排名第十三，在报告了可能的动力输出问题后。
兰多·诺里斯也在周三的车手新闻发布会上被问及《GTA VI》，并透露在他年轻的时候不允许玩这个系列。
最终练习和排位赛将于周五进行，周六晚上将举行拉斯维加斯大奖赛。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton plans "GTA VI" session after Vegas FP2: "I'm like a big kid"
The Ferrari driver told fans in Las Vegas he would head back to his hotel early on Thursday night to play the newly released game
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Lewis Hamilton finished sixth in a slippery second practice for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, before what he had promised fans would be an early night at his hotel with the newly released Grand Theft Auto VI.
The seven-time world champion was speaking on stage at PUMA's Under the Lights fan event at its Las Vegas store on Tuesday night, two days before the game's release.
"There's a new game coming out in two days," Hamilton told the crowd, before setting out his plans for Thursday, when second practice finished at 9pm local time.
"So on Thursday night, I'll be back at the hotel early," he said.
"I'm like a big kid," he added, before telling older fans in the crowd that he hoped they could tap into their own inner child.
The 41-year-old's admission came at the same event where he revealed his love of collecting Pokemon cards, and said he had taken his niece and nephews to buy packs.
GTA VI, the first new main game in Rockstar's series since GTA V in 2013, was released on Thursday after several delays.

Asked about it again during media day on Wednesday, Hamilton confirmed he had his PlayStation with him in Las Vegas, and called it the "most anticipated game ever". He joked, though, that the F1 game was the one more likely to help him get a better result.

Before any gaming, Hamilton had work to do. Ferrari junior Dino Beganovic drove his car in first practice, which was ruined by rain with no lap times set, making second practice Hamilton's only real running of the day.

On a damp track, with temperatures as low as 11C, he and Charles Leclerc briefly ran first and second on intermediate tyres before the track kept improving. Hamilton ended the session sixth, 1.211 seconds behind timesheet leader George Russell, with Leclerc third.

Hamilton isn't the only driver looking forward to kicking back with a controller in-hand. Max Verstappen, one of the paddock's best-known gamers, said it was "already pre-downloaded", but admitted he "just didn't have the time yet to play". Verstappen was 13th in FP2 after reporting potential power delivery issues.
Lando Norris was also asked about GTA VI in Wednesday's drivers' press conference, and revealed that he was not allowed to play the series when he was younger.
Final practice and qualifying take place on Friday, with the Las Vegas Grand Prix on Saturday night.

detailEn: Lewis Hamilton launches alien-themed Area 44 collection for Las Vegas GP
The Ferrari driver's fashion label has released a UFO-themed range for race week, including the brand's first knitwear
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Seven-time Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton's fashion label +44 has returned to Las Vegas with Area 44, an alien-themed collection released ahead of this weekend's grand prix.
The range is on sale through the +44 website and at a pop-up on the Encore Esplanade at Wynn Las Vegas, which runs until Sunday.

The Briton showed it off to his followers on Instagram. "AREA 44 - Collection online now. Inspired by the universe, Las Vegas, and all things unknown. Hope you enjoy," he wrote, in a post that had passed 305,000 likes at the time of writing.

The name is a play on Area 51, the secretive US Air Force base in the Nevada desert north of the city, and the theme runs through every piece. Items carry names such as Ground Crew, Night Shift, Close Encounter, First Contact and Redacted, and an alien head sits at the centre of the +44 cross on several of them.

The most expensive item is the Ground Crew bomber jacket at $250, which has an embroidered alien patch on the back and a printed Vegas Area +44 lining. The Night Shift windbreaker, at $175, has a +44 logo across its back, printed in ink that glows in the dark.
T-shirts start at $65, with socks, caps, tote bags and keyrings also in the collection.
The headline addition is the Experimental Lab Knit, a $130 wool-and-cashmere-blend jumper in Nevada Sand or Blackout. It is the first knitwear the label has made.

"Race week in Las Vegas is like nowhere else, so it felt right to create something just for it. Area +44 plays with that sense of mystery and the unknown, but at its heart it's about clothes you can really live in, pieces that layer up and take you from the track to the city, day to night," Hamilton said.
"We've explored new materials, details and silhouettes with this collection, and I'm really proud that we're introducing knitwear to +44 for the first time."

Hamilton is currently in the fight for second in the drivers' championship. The Las Vegas Grand Prix kicks off the season-ending triple-header, which includes the Qatar and Abu Dhabi Grands Prix. The 41-year-old sits fourth in the standings with 261 points, one point behind Mercedes' George Russell in third and 18 points behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen in second.

items.summaryEn: Hadjar said his first season as Max Verstappen's team-mate at Red Bull has opened his eyes to why the Dutchman is a four-time Formula 1 world champion.
detailZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔：“我明白了马克斯为何是四届世界冠军。”
这位红牛车手表示，与马克斯·维斯塔潘并肩作战的首个赛季中，既有让他自己感到意外的时刻，也有让他看清队友为何特别的时刻。
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
伊萨克·哈贾尔表示，作为马克斯·维斯塔潘在红牛的队友的首个赛季，让他看清了这位荷兰车手为何能成为四届F1世界冠军。
哈贾尔从小红牛（小红牛）升上来，为他的2026赛季效力，占据了F1中与维斯塔潘并肩作战、压力最大的席位之一。
在拉斯维加斯的媒体日上，当被问及是否达到了自己的期望时，这位法国人承认既有高潮也有低谷。
“有些时刻我在速度上让自己都感到惊讶，”哈贾尔说。“也有些时候我就像……我明白了为什么马克斯是四届世界冠军。”
他补充道：“所以两端都有一些顿悟的时刻。我会说我已经做得和我想要的一样好了。在赛季开始时，我肯定会签下这样的一年。”
当被问及那些时刻是何时出现时，哈贾尔说：“我认为主要是在周日。”
他特别挑出了两场比赛，其中一场是他受伤期间在家观看的。
“即使坐在沙发上，我觉得蒙扎的那场比赛也让我印象深刻，”哈贾尔说，并称那是维斯塔潘最强的比赛之一。他还指出了“他在巴西一路超车的方式”。
哈贾尔在夏休期训练中手腕骨折，因此错过了荷兰、意大利和马德里赛道的比赛周末。而在蒙扎，维斯塔潘获得第三名，排在两辆梅赛德斯赛车之后。
在圣保罗，维斯塔潘从第21位发车，最终以第二名完赛，落后于分站冠军兰多·诺里斯，哈贾尔则登上领奖台最后一席。
哈贾尔在代表一队出战的处子赛季表现强劲。他已三次登上领奖台——摩纳哥、阿塞拜疆和圣保罗——并以122分位列车手积分榜第八。
与此同时，维斯塔潘连续八次登上领奖台，目前在年度冠军争夺中排名第二。哈贾尔表示，他并未因身后排队等待的红牛车手而感到任何压力。
“我觉得整个职业生涯我从未向后看过。我实现了进入红牛的目标。我会在这里待上一段时间。所以是的，我并不真的觉得受到任何威胁，”他说。
“去年我在小红牛的菜鸟赛季已经证明了自己的实力。所以没错，今年在红牛的第一年我干得相当不错。明年会更好。”
detailEn: Isack Hadjar: "I realised why Max is a four-time world champion"
The Red Bull driver says his first season alongside Max Verstappen has brought moments where he surprised himself, and moments that showed him what makes his team-mate special
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Isack Hadjar says his first season as Max Verstappen's team-mate at Red Bull has opened his eyes to why the Dutchman is a four-time Formula 1 world champion.
Hadjar moved up from Racing Bulls for his 2026 campaign, taking one of the most pressured seats in F1 alongside Verstappen.
Asked during media day in Las Vegas whether he had lived up to his own expectations, the Frenchman admitted there had been both highs and lows.
"There's been moments where I've been surprising myself pace-wise," Hadjar said. "And there's been times where I was like... I realised why Max is a four-time world champion."
He added: "So there's been a few moments of realisations in both ends. I would say I've done as good as I wanted to. I would have definitely signed for a year like that at the start of the season."
Asked when those moments had come, Hadjar said: "Mostly Sundays, I think."
He picked out two races in particular, including one he watched from home while injured.
"Even on my couch, I think the race in Monza, I was very impressed," Hadjar said, calling it one of Verstappen's strongest races. He also pointed to "the way he comes through the field in Brazil".
Hadjar missed the Dutch, Italian and Madrid race weekends after fracturing his wrist in training during the summer break. And in Monza, Verstappen finished third behind the two Mercedes cars.
In Sao Paulo, Verstappen started 21st and finished second behind race winner Lando Norris, with Hadjar rounding out the podium on the bottom step.
Hadjar has had a strong debut season with the senior team. He has scored three podiums - Monaco, Azerbaijan and Sao Paulo - and is eighth in the drivers' standings on 122 points.
Verstappen, meanwhile, is second in the championship amid on a run of eight consecutive podiums. Hadjar said he did not feel any pressure from the Red Bull drivers queuing up behind him.
"I think my whole career I've never looked backwards. I achieved my goal to be at Red Bull. I'm here to stay for a while. So yeah, I don't really feel threatened by anything," he said.
"I've proved my point last year in my rookie season at Racing Bulls. So yeah, I'm doing my job pretty well here at Red Bull for the first year. Next year is going to be better."

麦凯轮车队首席执行官表示，车队宁愿将赛车卖给收藏家，也不愿让它们像堆在架子上一样闲置

麦凯轮赛车首席执行官Zak Brown解释了为什么在赛车甚至还没转一圈的情况下，沃金克车队就要将其F1赛车拍卖出去，他说另一种选择是将它们藏起来
麦凯轮车队将在12月9日阿布扎比的RM Sotheby's拍卖会上拍卖其2027年的赛车MCL41，拍卖会将在赛季决赛三天后举行。一辆由兰多·诺里斯或奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里使用的底盘将与2027年规格的梅赛德斯动力单元一同出售。
这紧随去年对本赛季赛车MCL40A的出售，该车在去年12月的阿布扎比RM Sotheby's拍卖会上以惊人的1148万美元成交。这是F1赛车首次在比赛前被出售。
由于旨在阻止竞争对手获取车队知识产权的规则，买家将不会在2028年之前收到那辆车，并且在此期间被提供一辆2025年的展示车。
在拉斯维加斯的团队负责人新闻发布会上被问及销售背后的想法时，布朗表示，这比将赛车锁起来更有意义。
“是的，另一种选择是把它们都包起来放在货架上，这真是太可惜了。我们有一个很棒的汽车业务，我们有一个非常热情的粉丝群，我们粉丝群中有一部分人对收集汽车有着浓厚的兴趣，”布朗说。
布朗本人也是一个热衷的汽车收藏家，他说去年的买家能够跟随他们的赛车整个赛季。
“因此，去年与苏富比合作，我们卖出了26辆车，有人有机会参与这次旅程，观看他们的赛车比赛，赢得一些比赛。所以我们至少一年要做一次这样的事情。这是我们打算做的事情，”他说。
麦克拉伦的2026款赛车在本赛季赢得了三场比赛，全部由诺里斯驾驶，分别在匈牙利、荷兰和巴西。车队目前在车手积分榜上排名第四，积分为398分，落后第三名的红牛17分。
今年的中标者将在2027赛季开始前参观麦凯轮的沃金总部，有机会见到布朗、诺里斯和皮亚斯特里，并受邀参加车队2027年的发布会。
布朗表示，这次销售让一小部分粉丝体验到了原本不存在的体验。
“我们有一个很好的生意。我们已经为我们的勒芒赛车制作了35辆赛道车，所以对我们来说，这是为我们那些处于特权地位、能够拥有一级方程式赛车的粉丝提供体验机会。否则，我们每年只制作四到五辆车，最后它们都堆在架子上，这对任何人都没有好处，”他说。
detailEn: Zak Brown explains why McLaren keeps selling F1 cars before they race ahead of 2027 auction
The McLaren CEO says the team would rather sell its cars to collectors than leave them "stacking up" on a shelf
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.
McLaren Racing CEO Zak Brown has explained why the Woking outfit is selling its Formula 1 cars at auction before they have even turned a wheel, saying the alternative is leaving them hidden away.

McLaren will auction its 2027 car, the MCL41, with RM Sotheby's in Abu Dhabi on 9 December, three days after the season finale. A chassis used by either Lando Norris or Oscar Piastri will be offered with a 2027-specification Mercedes power unit.

It follows last year's sale of this season's car, the MCL40A, which went for a staggering $11.48million at RM Sotheby's Abu Dhabi sale last December. It was the first time an F1 car had been sold before it had raced.
The buyer will not receive that car until 2028, because of rules designed to stop rivals getting access to a team's intellectual property, and was offered a 2025 show car to display in the meantime.
Asked in the team principals' press conference in Las Vegas about the thinking behind the sales, Brown said it made more sense than locking the cars away.

"Yeah, the other alternative is you leave them all on shelves under wraps, which is a shame. We have a great automotive business, we have a very passionate fan base, and we have a certain part of our fan base that has a passion to collect cars," Brown said.
Brown, a keen car collector himself, said last year's buyer had been able to follow their car all season.

"And so last year with Sotheby's, we sold '26 cars and someone had the ability to come on the journey, watch their car race, win some races. And so we're going to do that once a year at least. That's our intention," he said.

McLaren's 2026 car has won three races this season, all with Norris, in Hungary, the Netherlands and Brazil. The team currently sits fourth in the constructors' championship with 398 points, 17 points behind Red Bull in third.
This year's winning bidder will get a tour of McLaren's Woking headquarters before the 2027 season, the chance to meet Brown, Norris and Piastri, and an invitation to the team's 2027 launch.
Brown said the sales gave a small group of fans an experience that would otherwise not exist.

"We have a nice business. We've done 35 track cars of our Le Mans car, so for us it's about experiential opportunities for those fans of ours that are in a privileged position to be able to own Formula 1 cars. Otherwise, we make four or five cars a year and they end up stacking up on a shelf, and that's no good for anybody," he said.

Mercedes' George Russell topped Practice Two from Alpine's Pierre Gasly as rain limited running on the opening day of track action at the Las Vegas Grand Prix.

After no timed laps were completed in first practice due to heavy rain falling throughout, the weather relented to allow plenty of running during the second session, albeit on a damp, slowly drying circuit that prevented the use of slick tyres.

The best lap times came at the end of the session, which took place on Thursday night in Las Vegas, when Russell pipped Gasly by 0.071s, with Ferrari's Charles Leclerc three tenths off the pace in third.

Leclerc and McLaren's Lando Norris, who won last time out in Brazil, had traded the fastest times for most of the session in the wetter conditions.

Norris ended up seventh, behind Red Bull's Isack Hadjar, his McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, but the times are likely to matter very little given qualifying and the race are expected to take place in dry conditions.

The schedule in Las Vegas runs a day earlier than a traditional F1 weekend, but the time difference means qualifying will take place at 4am on Saturday morning for UK viewers, with race following at the same time on Sunday.

Remarkably, there were few incidents and the only red flag across the whole day was for a plastic bag blowing onto the circuit at the high-speed final corner in second practice.
New F1 world champion Kimi Antonelli was eighth fastest but will serve a five-place grid penalty after exceeding his internal combustion engine allocation for a second time this season.
Piastri, Williams' Carlos Sainz and Aston Martin's Lance Stroll have 10-place grid penalties for going over various power unit elements, while Haas' Oliver Bearman will start at the back.
Red Bull's Max Verstappen battles the rain during the first practice session at the Las Vegas GP
Max Verstappen spent most of the day in the garage and completed only 10 laps in total as he finished second practice in 13th.

Verstappen, who is on a run of eight consecutive podiums, felt he had "no power" from the engine on the laps he completed and insisted "it was not normal" despite his engineer suggesting the issue was related to the power unit needing to warm up in the cold condtions.

Final practice, which gets under way at 12.30am on Saturday for UK viewers, is set to be very busy as the drivers will attempt to get plenty of dry laps in before qualifying.
